tool_schemas.name: book_trip
tool_schemas.description: Book a flight and a hotel together and charge the corporate card.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded only when a request completes. A request that failed partway is not recorded: part of it may have taken effect, and repeating it with the same key runs it again. After a failure or timeout, check current state before retrying.

tool_schemas.name: book_flight
tool_schemas.description: Book a single flight (charges the corporate card).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded when a request completes; a repeated request with the same key is not executed again.

tool_schemas.name: book_hotel

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded when a request completes; a repeated request with the same key is not executed again.

tool_schemas.name: list_reservations

tool_schemas.description: Cancel a reservation and refund it.
